review_isolation_levels.system-readonly: The parent session is actually read-only, or a valid controlled probe is explicitly denied by the sandbox; suitable for strict read-only review.
review_isolation_levels.logical-readonly: The parent session can write and the Reviewer relies on behavioral instructions not to write; system isolation must not be claimed.
review_isolation_levels.self-review: An implementation Agent reviews its own work; this does not replace an independent Reviewer.
